units.source_text: 他辞了女御，又去访问皇太子。

en.t: He took leave of the consort and then went to visit the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 他想皇太子是三公主的嫡亲哥哥，相貌一定有些肖似，便对他注意观察。

en.t: Thinking that the Crown Prince was the Third Princess's own elder brother and must resemble her somewhat in appearance, he observed him closely.

units.source_text: 皇太子的容颜虽然并不艳丽，但因身份尊贵，气色毕竟与众不同，高尚而又优雅。

en.t: Although the Crown Prince's features were not especially dazzling, his noble rank gave him a bearing unlike others, refined and graceful.

units.source_text: 宫中的猫生了许多小猫，分配在各处宫室中，皇太子也分得一只。

en.t: A palace cat had given birth to many kittens, which were distributed among the various residences, and the Crown Prince received one as well.

units.source_text: 柏木看见这只小猫走来走去，样子非常可爱，便想起了三公主那只小猫，对皇太子说道：“

en.t: Seeing this kitten wandering about so adorably, Kashiwagi remembered the Third Princess's kitten and said to the Crown Prince, "

units.source_text: 六条院三公主那里有一只小猫，其相貌之漂亮，从来不曾见过，真可爱啊！

en.t: At Rokujo-in, the Third Princess has a kitten whose beauty I have never seen equaled; it is truly adorable!
I once caught just a faint glimpse of it."

units.source_text: 皇太子原是特别喜欢猫的，便向他仔细探询那只猫的情状。

en.t: The Crown Prince had always been especially fond of cats, so he questioned him closely about what that kitten was like.

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“那只猫是中国产，样子和我们这里的不同。

en.t: Kashiwagi replied, "That kitten comes from China, and its appearance is different from the cats we have here.

units.source_text: 同样是猫，然而这猫性情温良，对人特别亲昵，真是怪可爱的！”

en.t: Though it is still a cat, its nature is gentle and good, and it is especially affectionate toward people; it is strangely lovable!"

units.source_text: 花言巧语，说得皇太子起了欲得之心。

en.t: With such smooth and artful words, he made the Crown Prince begin to want the kitten for himself.
